# firebase_auth

**Tag**: firebase, authentication, identity, sign-in, sign-up, mobile, security, state-management

## 简介

Flutter plugin for Firebase Auth, enabling authentication using passwords, phone numbers and identity providers like Google, Facebook and Twitter.

## 官网

- 主页: https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/firebase/flutterfire/tree/main/packages/firebase_auth/firebase_auth
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_auth
